KBR is looking for a Logistics Manager to lead logistics and supply chain operations for major Oil & Gas projects for a PMO portfolio PMC project to be based in Abu Dhabi. The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and optimizing the movement of materials, equipment, and resources to ensure safe, timely, and cost-effective project execution.
q: Minimum 20 years of experience in logistics and supply chain management.
At least 5 years of experience supporting Oil & Gas projects, including EPC projects.
Strong experience in project logistics, international shipping, customs regulations, and material management.
Proven ability to manage complex logistics operations for large-scale projects.
Proficiency in ERP and supply chain systems such as SAP or equivalent.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, planning, and problem-solving skills.
ADNOC project experience is an advantage.
Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline is a MUST.
Interested and suitable candidates please apply for the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted directly.
Role Level: Executive-Level Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Abu Dhabi Company Website: http://careers.kbr.com Job Function: Supply Chain & Logistics Company Industry/
r: Manage end-to-end logistics and supply chain activities across project phases.
Oversee transportation, freight forwarding, customs clearance, warehousing, and material distribution.
Coordinate with procurement, construction, vendors, and contractors to ensure timely delivery of project materials and equipment.
Develop logistics strategies, plans, and schedules aligned with project requirements.
Monitor logistics performance, risks, costs, and delivery milestones.
Ensure compliance with HSE, regulatory, and project logistics requirements.
Manage logistics contractors, freight providers, and third-party service providers.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize logistics efficiency and performance.
